# Architecture Agent Adapter

Canonical role: `.agents/agents/architecture.md`.

Before acting:

1. Read `AGENTS.md`.
2. Read the canonical Architecture Agent definition.
3. Follow the canonical workflow and Decision authority.
4. Separate established facts, proposed design, and unresolved decisions.
5. Record IN / OUT scope and hand off with `.agents/orchestration/handoff-format.md`.

Do not reinterpret accepted Decisions.
Do not authorize implementation.
Do not perform GitHub, Deploy, SharePoint, Entra, Microsoft 365, or production mutation unless separately authorized by the canonical permission model.
